decisions.title: 2025 Infrastructure Capital Improvements Plan Priorities
decisions.description: The enacted 2025 resolution establishes City Council priorities for the infrastructure capital improvements plan, guiding investment across streets, drainage, transit, parks, public safety, housing, facilities, technology, redevelopment, resilience, and other public infrastructure.
decisions.provenance_status: official City Legistar attachment; rendered R-25-126 matter record verified

decisions.title: 2025-2034 Decade Plan for Capital Improvements
decisions.description: The enacted resolution approves Albuquerque's 2025-2034 decade plan and 2025 two-year capital budget, programming general-obligation investments for streets, drainage, parks, transit, housing, public safety, community facilities, technology, redevelopment, and neighborhood priorities.
decisions.provenance_status: official City Legistar attachment; rendered R-25-117 matter record verified

decisions.title: 2023-2032 Decade Plan for Capital Improvements
decisions.description: The enacted 2023 resolution programs the City's 2023-2032 decade plan and two-year capital budget, allocating projects across infrastructure, transit, parks, public safety, housing, community facilities, and the City's general-obligation bond purposes.
decisions.provenance_status: official City Legistar attachment; rendered R-23-100 matter record verified

decisions.title: 2021-2030 Decade Plan for Capital Improvements
decisions.description: The enacted 2021 resolution approves the 2021-2030 decade plan and two-year capital budget, programming general-obligation investments in streets, drainage, parks, transit, public safety, housing, community facilities, and neighborhood infrastructure.
decisions.provenance_status: official City Legistar attachment; rendered R-21-128 matter record verified

decisions.title: Capital Improvements Plan Community Equity Criterion
decisions.description: The enacted resolution adds a community-equity criterion to Albuquerque's capital-improvements planning, directing the City to prioritize investment in socially vulnerable and geographically inequitable areas when developing capital programs.
decisions.provenance_status: official City Legistar attachment; rendered R-20-85 matter record verified
